Preview: Supplying the Settlers

Greetings everyone! As part of our effort to bring great and fun content to our playerbase, we would like to introduced a new in-game activity: Supplying the Settlers This event will center around bringing Food Supplies to Auroran Settlers, to ensure the conquest of Auroria can keep going at maximum efficiency!

This materializes with the arrival of a group of Sushi Chefs on the three Freedich Outposts. These Chefs will have a small mission for you...

Bringing the Ice

The Sushi Chefs will bring along a few boxes waiting to be filled with Ice. Players will have to figure out how to obtain some \[Pure Ice Pack]s to bring them down to the Ice Boxes and fill them up. Bringing a \[Pure Ice Pack] will have the Sushi Chef reward you with a small amount of \[Lord's Pence]

{.article-img}

Sashimi?

Once an Ice Box is filled, the Sushi Chef will be able to prepare Fish Fillets! At this stage of the event, you'll need to go out to Sea and sportsfish! The Sushi Chef will trade any Saltwater Fish for 1 [Fish Fillet] and any Gargantuan Saltwater Fish for 2 [Fish Fillet]s

With the Fish Fillet in your possession you'll then be able get some Ice at a filled \[Icebox], to obtain a \[Fish Food Supplies Pack]

{.article-img}

Feed the Settlers

Now the final step: Bring the \[Fish Food Supplies Pack] to one of the Auroran Settlements! The pack exchangers are located near the Enoans of each Auroran zone.

Once you turn in Food Supplies, like a resource tradepack, you will receive a set amount of \[Lord's Pence], influenced by the percentage of the zone you are trading with.

{.article-img}

Conclusion

We hope this event will bring some dynamic, small scale PvP that ArcheAge excels at.

As a last note, the Sushi Chef will work similarily to the Gold Trader and will only be present during certain timeslots of the day!

You'll be able to help the settlers in patch 1.2.10, slated for release on the 12th of June!

== Preview: Supplying the Settlers ==

Greetings everyone! As part of our effort to bring great and fun content to our playerbase, we would like to introduced a new in-game activity: Supplying the Settlers
This event will center around bringing Food Supplies to Auroran Settlers, to ensure the conquest of Auroria can keep going at maximum efficiency!

This materializes with the arrival of a group of Sushi Chefs on the three Freedich Outposts. These Chefs will have a small mission for you...

== Bringing the Ice ==
The Sushi Chefs will bring along a few boxes waiting to be filled with Ice. Players will have to figure out how to obtain some \[Pure Ice Pack]s to bring them down to the Ice Boxes and fill them up.
Bringing a \[Pure Ice Pack] will have the Sushi Chef reward you with a small amount of \[Lord's Pence]

[[File:News news-sushi-freed map.png|500px|link=|alt=suhsi_map]]{.article-img}

== Sashimi? ==
Once an Ice Box is filled, the Sushi Chef will be able to prepare Fish Fillets! At this stage of the event, you'll need to go out to Sea and sportsfish! The Sushi Chef will trade any Saltwater Fish for 1 [Fish Fillet] and any Gargantuan Saltwater Fish for 2 [Fish Fillet]s

With the Fish Fillet in your possession you'll then be able get some Ice at a filled \[Icebox], to obtain a \[Fish Food Supplies Pack]

[[File:News news-sushi-chef2.png|500px|link=|alt=suhsi_map]]{.article-img}

== Feed the Settlers ==
Now the final step: Bring the \[Fish Food Supplies Pack] to one of the Auroran Settlements! The pack exchangers are located near the Enoans of each Auroran zone.

Once you turn in Food Supplies, like a resource tradepack, you will receive a set amount of \[Lord's Pence], influenced by the percentage of the zone you are trading with.

[[File:News news-sushi-pack arrive.png|500px|link=|alt=pack_arrives]]{.article-img}

== Conclusion ==
We hope this event will bring some dynamic, small scale PvP that ArcheAge excels at.

As a last note, the Sushi Chef will work similarily to the Gold Trader and will only be present during certain timeslots of the day!

== You'll be able to help the settlers in patch 1.2.10, slated for release on the 12th of June! ==
